name: SDP My Account Tabs for WooCommerce
author: Simple Direct Plugins

sections.description:
SDP My Account Tabs for WooCommerce lets you fully customize the WooCommerce My Account page by adding, reordering, and renaming tabs. You can display dynamic user-related information, including WordPress profile data (name, avatar, registration date, bio, website, and any custom user meta key) and WooCommerce details (billing/shipping info, orders, total spent, coupons, purchased products, among others). The plugin also includes a flexible shortcode to display any user meta key, allowing developers and site owners to output custom fields added by themes or plugins without additional coding.

🚀 Try the live interactive demo

Try the live interactive demo and explore a fully customized WooCommerce My Account area with dynamic customer content, custom tabs, recent orders, and personalized account sections.

Launch live demo

Using Elementor Pro? Turn your WooCommerce My Account page into a fully personalized customer dashboard. Insert your templates into custom tabs and power them with dynamic SMAT shortcodes.

The plugin automatically detects any custom tabs added to the WooCommerce My Account page by third-party plugins —such as Bookings, Subscriptions, EU VAT Number, and others— and integrates them seamlessly. This ensures that all tabs, whether native or added by external plugins, are fully compatible and manageable within the SDP My Account Tabs interface.

In the Pro version, you can also insert dynamic data from WooCommerce Subscriptions, WooCommerce Memberships, WooCommerce Bookings, WooCommerce EU VAT Number, and BuddyPress, giving you ultimate control over the My Account experience for each user.

⚙️ Features

  • Add custom tabs to WooCommerce My Account page.
  • Reorder tabs using a drag-and-drop interface.
  • Rename WooCommerce core and third-party plugins tabs.
  • Hide WooCommerce core and third-party plugins tabs.
  • Add custom content or shortcodes to tabs.
  • Display dynamic user data:
    • WordPress: name, avatar, registration date, bio, website, any custom user meta key, and more.
    • WooCommerce: billing/shipping info, orders, total spent, available coupons, purchased products, and much more.
  • Shortcode to display any WordPress user meta key.
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce core endpoints (Orders, Downloads, Addresses, etc.).
  • Detects and supports custom My Account tabs created by other plugins
  • Integrates with payment methods.
  • Translations ready.
  • Completely translated into Spanish.

💎 Pro Version

Unlock the full potential of SDP My Account Tabs Pro with these advanced features:

  • Create conditional tabs for specific user roles, individual users, purchased products, or active memberships (WooCommerce Memberships).
  • Display user-specific data from WooCommerce Subscriptions, WooCommerce Memberships, WooCommerce Bookings, WooCommerce EU VAT Number, and BuddyPress.
  • Priority support and updates.

Upgrade now to provide a tailored, data-rich My Account experience for your users!
sections.faq:
What dynamic user data can be inserted into custom tabs?

You can display dynamic customer information inside your custom My Account tabs using built-in shortcodes from WordPress and WooCommerce.

WordPress user data

  • Username
  • First name
  • Last name
  • Nickname
  • Display name
  • Email address
  • Website
  • Biography
  • Profile picture (custom size supported)
  • User role
  • Registration date
  • Any custom user meta (by meta key)

WooCommerce customer data

Billing details:
– Billing first name
– Billing last name
– Billing company
– Billing address line 1
– Billing address line 2
– Billing postcode
– Billing city
– Billing state
– Billing country
– Billing phone
– Customer email

Shipping details:
– Shipping first name
– Shipping last name
– Shipping company
– Shipping address line 1
– Shipping address line 2
– Shipping postcode
– Shipping city
– Shipping state
– Shipping country
– Shipping phone

Order information:
– Last order date
– Last order total
– Last order ID (optional link)
– Purchased products (with quantity limit option)
– Number of orders
– Total amount spent
– Orders table (with configurable limit)
– Downloads table
– Available coupons

Order-related shortcodes support filters to control which order statuses are included in the calculation.

Can the plugin be translated into other languages?

Yes, it’s fully compatible with translation files and multilingual plugins such as WPML, and comes with a complete Spanish translation included.
